decision: Pre-GA preview may include explicitly disclosed documented GA intent and provisional reference material. Pending proof is retained; this approval is not execution or stable readiness. Local feasible checks, complete offline content, source accuracy and input freshness remain mandatory.

exceptions.scope: Final package qualification is deferred by Pingu; no Human approval or successful direct materialization is inferred. Actual-GA reconciliation remains outstanding; PIN-959 permits this explicitly provisional preview.

GA documentation removed the direct-TLS include; NuGet index offers only RC1, not 11.0.0. RC1 lacks the former documented DirectTlsEndpoint. Current canonical code is ordinary socket HTTPS, not a direct-TLS implementation. Linux/OpenSSL transport selection and negotiation remain not-tested under the native policy. Actual supported direct-TLS artifact/scenario availability remains a PIN-967 stable-gate condition. Pending stable gate is actual supported artifact/scenario availability. Linux/OpenSSL execution remains excluded as not-tested under the existing native policy; no new hardware qualification is requested.
